title: Question 8
passage:
Do you have any cash for the farmers market?
A. The bank closes at noon on Saturdays. B. I already have enough bags for the produce. C. No, but there's an ATM on the way.
passageZh:
你有現金可以在農夫市集用嗎？
A. 銀行星期六中午關門。
B. 我已經準備好足夠的袋子裝蔬果了。
C. 沒有，不過路上有提款機。
